parrafo.es: Escondido detrás del Texaco en SW 136th St, en Kendall, KC's Hand Wash lleva años cuidando autos en Miami: desde la SUV familiar hasta el Lamborghini que pasa un sábado. Rudy y su equipo lavan, encerán y detallan cada auto con el mismo cuidado.
parrafo.en: Tucked behind the Texaco on SW 136th St in Kendall, KC's Hand Wash has been taking care of Miami's cars for years, from the family SUV to the Lamborghini that rolls through on a Saturday. Rudy and his team wash, wax and detail every car with the same care.

hero.imagen_alt: Lamborghini Sto freshly detailed at KC's Hand Wash, Kendall

parrafo_1.es: KC's Hand Wash está detrás del Texaco en SW 136th St, en la zona de Country Walk / Kendall. Rudy lo dirige desde hace años, y las reseñas lo dicen mejor que nadie: clientes que vuelven desde hace diez, hasta dieciséis años seguidos.
parrafo_1.en: KC's Hand Wash sits behind the Texaco on SW 136th St, in the Country Walk / Kendall area. Rudy has been running it for years, and the reviews say it best: customers who keep coming back for ten, even sixteen years straight.

parrafo_2.es: Cada auto recibe la misma atención, sea uno de uso diario que pasa antes del trabajo o un Lamborghini, Porsche o Aston Martin que llega un sábado. Lavado a mano, encerado, clay bar o detailing completo: el equipo de Rudy y Javi lo hace a mano, bajo la carpa.
parrafo_2.en: Every car gets the same attention, whether it is a daily driver dropping off before work or a Lamborghini, Porsche or Aston Martin stopping by on a Saturday. Hand wash, wax, clay bar or a full detail, Rudy and Javi's team do it by hand, right there under the tent.

texto.es: No hace falta cita. Entras, dejas el auto y Rudy o Javi te dicen cuánto va a tomar.
texto.en: No appointment needed. Pull in, hand off the car, and Rudy or Javi will tell you how long it will take.

texto.es: Lavado a mano, encerado, clay bar o detailing completo: te dicen el precio en el momento, sin sorpresas.
texto.en: Hand wash, wax, clay bar or a full detail: you get the price on the spot, no surprises.

texto.es: Nada de túneles automáticos. Cada panel, cada rin y cada rincón se limpia a mano, bajo la carpa.
texto.en: No automatic tunnels. Every panel, every wheel and every corner gets cleaned by hand, under the tent.

texto.es: Revisas el trabajo antes de irte. Si algo no te convence, Rudy lo arregla ahí mismo.
texto.en: You check the work before you leave. If something is not quite right, Rudy fixes it right there.

nota.es: Cada servicio se cotiza según el auto, en el momento. Llama o pasa por SW 136th St y te decimos el precio.
nota.en: Every service is quoted based on the car, on the spot. Call or stop by SW 136th St and we will give you the price.

texto.es: Exterior lavado a mano, rines y llantas detallados, y secado con toalla para un acabado sin marcas.
texto.en: Hand-washed exterior, detailed wheels and tires, and a towel-dry finish with no streaks.

texto.es: Lavado a mano más una capa de cera que protege la pintura y deja un brillo que se nota apenas sales del lote.
texto.en: Hand wash plus a coat of wax that protects the paint and leaves a shine you notice the moment you pull out.

texto.es: Clay bar para levantar la contaminación que el lavado normal no saca, dejando la pintura lisa al tacto.
texto.en: Clay bar to lift the contamination a regular wash cannot touch, leaving the paint smooth to the hand.

texto.es: Interior y exterior a fondo: el mismo cuidado que ves en los deportivos que pasan un sábado cualquiera.
texto.en: Interior and exterior, done thoroughly: the same care you see on the sports cars that roll through on any given Saturday.

pie.es: ¿No ves lo que buscas? Pregunta igual, seguro Rudy y su equipo lo resuelven.
pie.en: Don't see what you're looking for? Ask anyway, Rudy and his team can likely handle it.

items.quote: I've been washing my cars with Rudy and his team for 10 years. They're efficient, professional, and always make you feel like family.
Incredible detailed service supervised by the greatest owner: Rudy. A true neighborhood OG who works his tail off, and treats you so personably, attentive and fair, without any price gauging.
Rudy and his staff did an incredible job on my car. Wash, waxed and detailed to perfection!
